title: two things to settle before this lands
preamble: Each card below states what was seen and what choosing an answer means for the change.

decisions.question: should the cache be read before the lock is taken
decisions.meaning: two callers arriving together read the same stale entry and both write it back.

options.label: leave it
options.command: agree c-1 --reason "the staleness is acceptable here"

decisions.question: which of these should the write path keep
decisions.meaning: the write path does three things and only one of them is what the caller asked for.

evidence.patch:
--- a/internal/cache/write.go
+++ b/internal/cache/write.go
@@ -10,4 +10,5 @@
 func Write(key string, entry Entry) {
-	store[key] = entry
+	mu.Lock()
+	store[key] = entry
+	mu.Unlock()
 }

fragment.markup: Writesone line each
